etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English expiracioun, exspiracioun (“vapor, breath”), from Latin expīrātiōnem, exspīrātiōnem, accusative singular of expīrātiō, exspīrātiō.

definitions.definition: (uncountable) The act or process of breathing out, or forcing air from the lungs through the nose or mouth.
Other similar release of volatile matter.
(euphemistic) The last emission of breath; thus, synonym of death.
Any other (metaphorically comparable) cessation, extinction, or ending.
That which is produced by breathing out, as a sound.
An act, process, or instance of expiring.
